title: OpenET ensemble evapotranspiration (field scale)
fetched: monthly ensemble ET, ensemble minimum and maximum for 14 fields; gridMET reference ET and precipitation at the pilot centre. Quota now: 44 used of 100
resolution: 30 m (Landsat thermal driven), aggregated to the field polygon; monthly
credit: OpenET (Melton et al. 2022, JAWRA). Ensemble of ALEXI/DisALEXI, eeMETRIC, geeSEBAL, PT-JPL, SIMS and SSEBop, built on Landsat and gridMET. CC BY 4.0.
message: 1,680 field-months for 14 fields; May-Sep model spread (max - min) is a median 35 % of ET; 34 repeated-value months flagged; sanity passed

checks.variable: annual ET mm (idle pivots can be very low)

notes: A model estimate of water actually evaporated and transpired, not a flow-meter reading. The newest six months can still be revised. Winter values are the least reliable (snow, few clear images) and some are repeated across months; those are flagged and left out of seasonal statistics. The field-boundary and field-ID endpoints (/geodatabase/...) returned HTTP 400 for every request, so polygons detected by this project are sent to the raster endpoint instead.
